grain: One row per enrollment school, school year, and geographic level (city_mun or bgy); overseas schools are retained as excluded.
used_by: analysis/cross_source/cross_source_deped_school_psgc_rule.py and src/integration/deped_school_psgc.py; generated SQL: etl/04_integration/01_map_deped_school_psgc.sql and its 90_validate gate
status: The matching rule was approved in PR #153 (2026-10-18); #91 applies it to the production Integration map.
how_to_change: Add or change an alias or override in a reviewed pull request with evidence and rationale, regenerate both Integration SQL files, rerun the tests and real-data reconciliation, and quote the changed match counts. Every override names its approving reviewer.
rule_order_note: rule_order describes the rule. The analysis functions test it on raw data; src/integration/deped_school_psgc.py generates the production SQL and is the executable source of truth. Change the generator, tests, and this list together. On Silver input, deped_enrollment_psgc_clean has already recoded Sulu 19066 to 09066 and sets psgc_recoded, so Integration takes code_region_moved from psgc_recoded. The generator reads the aliases and overrides below; the analysis rule reads the overrides and uses the same reviewed aliases from cross_source_deped.py.

city_mun: A reviewed override for the school's DepEd place, if one is listed below; it picks the unit, and the method follows the side it uses (code when the name match agrees, otherwise code_name_differs). The Integration SQL applies barangay overrides only, so the generator refuses a city_mun override until it is implemented there

Special Geographic Area school (D-031): one DepEd files under a special_geographic_area source place below, or whose EMISD code is in a Special Geographic Area municipality (psgc_prefix; SY 2020-21 still files these schools under Region XII). Matched by code when the DepEd barangay name matches the barangay of the EMISD code and that barangay lies inside the code's municipality, so the school is in one of the eight Special Geographic Area municipalities (D-031's condition, D-049); otherwise excluded, with psgc_code NULL
EMISD code and name match give the same unit: matched, method code

They give different units: matched by code when the DepEd barangay name matches the barangay of the EMISD code and that barangay lies inside the code's city or municipality (the place moved, e.g. a newer municipality or Embo), method code_name_differs; otherwise ambiguous
Only one of them is found: matched by it (code_name_differs for the code, or the name tier's method)
A Manila sub-municipality matched by code or name rolls up to the City of Manila, method rollup; a Sulu code read under region 09 is code_region_moved
bgy: The city or municipality is not matched (excluded, ambiguous or unmatched): the barangay gets the same status, with psgc_code NULL
A reviewed override for the school's DepEd place, if one is listed below; it picks the unit, and the method follows the side it uses (code when the name match agrees, otherwise code_name_differs)
EMISD code and name match give the same barangay: matched, method code
The code's barangay name matches the DepEd barangay name: matched by code, method code
They give different barangays otherwise: ambiguous
Only one of them is found: matched by it (code_name_differs for the code, or the name tier's method)
Any barangay accepted above, an override included, must lie inside the accepted city or municipality; otherwise ambiguous (this catches EMISD codes that break the PSGC hierarchy, profile O-7)

gate.min_match_rate_note: matched / (rows - excluded) per school year and level; the gate FAILs and publishes nothing below it. The lowest on the 2026-10-19 deliveries is SY 2020-21 barangay, 99.63%.
gate.profiled_counts_note: Reviewed matched / ambiguous / unmatched / excluded counts per school year and level, from evidence/reconciliation/2026-10-19-deped-school-psgc-integration.md. The gate PASSes at these counts and FAILs before publication when they change; update them in the reviewed pull request that explains the change.

special_geographic_area.evidence: SY 2023-24 files all 112 schools coded 19999 under BARMM / NORTH COTABATO; SY 2024-25 and 2025-26 add BARMM / (SGA - North Cotabato) (7 and 8 schools, 5 and 6 of them not in the EMISD crosswalk); SY 2020-21 files the 111 schools coded 19999 under Region XII / NORTH COTABATO. See evidence/reconciliation/2026-10-19-deped-school-psgc-integration.md.

overrides.reason: DepEd names the barangay before it was split. PSGC 2Q 2026 lists Signal Village only as an old name of Central Signal Village, so the name match puts every Signal Village school there. The EMISD codes spread the same schools over North, Central and South Signal Village and Katuparan, all in Taguig. The code names the barangay each school is in. The name match cannot.
overrides.evidence: 21 SY 2023-24 schools carry this DepEd barangay; for 14 of them the EMISD code and the name match disagree. Rerun cross_source_deped_enrollment_psgc.py: EP-18 counts both, the 14 are the SIGNAL VILLAGE rows of work/deped_enrollment_psgc_vs_name_match.csv (EP-11), and EP-16 counts the override as applied.
